label: karooMQTT
description: Publishes indoor-training power and heart-rate data to a local MQTT broker. Activates automatically on trainer (indoor) profiles, keeps Wi-Fi alive during indoor rides, and exposes MQTT/Wi-Fi status fields for ride profiles.
releaseNotes: Auto-start on indoor profiles, MQTT online/offline status topic, colored MQTT/Wi-Fi data fields, service auto-stop after ride.
